name: Validate floorplan border buffer
instructions: Run this check while drafting floor-only intermediate maps, before wall derivation.
Room floor interiors should not touch the outer edge of the target canvas unless the user explicitly requests border-touching rooms.
Leave at least one empty tile between room floor interiors and the outer canvas edge so wall derivation can create a clean exterior wall layer.
Hallways should also avoid touching the outer edge unless intentionally becoming an exterior entrance path.
If a room or hallway touches the border unintentionally, move it inward, shrink it, or trim the target footprint before deriving walls.
This rule reduces exposed floors, accidental exterior doors, double exterior walls, and ragged edge artifacts.
allowedExceptions: intentional map-edge opening validated later as a legal exterior door
